description.value: Subway at Mariner Square Shopping Centre is a full-service fast-food sandwich shop serving Footlongs, 6" subs, wraps, and salads in Campbell River. It accepts multiple major credit cards and offers in-restaurant dining, pickup, curbside, and delivery. For touring cyclists passing through Campbell River, it is a reliable mid-route calorie stop with flexible ordering options.

address.value: 1400 Dogwood Street, Suite 320, Campbell River, BC V9W 3A6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Subway location at 1400 Dogwood Street, Suite 320, Campbell River in Mariner Square Shopping Centre. Phone (250) 287-7080 matches OSM exactly. The website explicitly lists takeout, delivery, and curbside pickup as ordering options. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi are mentioned on the page; absence of evidence yields null, not false.
concerns: OSM opening_hours (Mo-We,Sa-Su 07:30-21:00; Th-Fr 07:30-22:00) do not match the website (Mon-Wed/Sat-Sun close 21:30; Thu-Fri open from 07:00). OSM hours appear slightly inaccurate.
OSM address fields are incomplete (only addr:unit=320 present, no street). Full address derived from website: 1400 Dogwood Street, Suite 320, Campbell River, BC V9W 3A6.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant confirmed by the Subway corporate website. A reliable food stop for touring cyclists in Campbell River.
